reason: required tool not found on PATH; CI script failed at require_tool()
common_fixes: install the missing tool (shellcheck, gitleaks, jq, gh, python3)
run: bash scripts/ci-doctor.sh to list all required tools with ok/MISSING status
repair_hint: run: bash scripts/ci-doctor.sh — exits 1 if any tool is absent; shows which lane failed

reason: install.sh URL does not match the contract declared in contracts/install-url.txt
common_fixes: restore the ${VERSION} variable in the install.sh download URL
run: bash ops/ci/contract-drift.sh to re-derive and diff
repair_hint: run: bash ops/ci/contract-drift.sh — re-derives URL from install.sh and diffs against contracts/install-url.txt

reason: README.md, FAMILY.md, and family.json are out of sync with each other
common_fixes: update all three files to agree on the family repo names
run: bash ops/ci/pr-ci.sh and look for the pointer-check step
repair_hint: run: bash ops/ci/pr-ci.sh — the pointer-check step shows which file is missing which entry

reason: engine code (*.rs or Cargo.toml) found in the hub repo
common_fixes: remove .rs files and Cargo.toml from the hub; all engine code belongs in redline-core
run: find . -name '*.rs' -not -path './target/*' to locate leaked source
repair_hint: run: find . -name '*.rs' -not -path './target/*' — any hits are engine leaks to remove

reason: gitleaks detected a committed secret or credential in the repo
common_fixes: remove the secret from git history using git-filter-repo
rotate the credential at the provider immediately
force-push the cleaned history and invalidate any cached git clones
repair_hint: run: gitleaks detect --no-banner --source . to reproduce; then remove, rotate, force-push
